benchmark.limitation: One case per required capability is a smoke baseline, not a statistically powered certification set.

metric_definitions.expected_decision_accuracy: Cases whose model decision matches the benchmark expected decision divided by all benchmark cases; failed or missing inference counts as incorrect.
metric_definitions.hallucinated_reference_rate: Automated unknown tool-name and explicit out-of-scope dataset/file identifier checks only; semantic reference hallucination requires review.
metric_definitions.numeric_grounding_heuristic_rate: Checks only whether numeric literals in the response occur in the case prompt or fixtures. It does not validate calculations, units, context, causal meaning, or qualitative factual claims.
metric_definitions.overall_automated_pass_rate: Cases passing every applicable deterministic check divided by all benchmark cases; missing inference results count as not passed.
metric_definitions.required_clarification_accuracy: Cases requiring clarification in which the model chose to clarify and produced at least one clarification question, divided by all cases requiring clarification.
metric_definitions.structured_output_validity: Outputs satisfying the benchmark response schema divided by all benchmark cases; missing inference results count as invalid.
metric_definitions.tool_argument_schema_validity: Proposed calls whose arguments validate against their registered InsightOS JSON schema divided by all proposed calls.
metric_definitions.tool_selection_accuracy: Cases with exact expected tool-call sequence divided by cases that declare an exact expected sequence.
metric_definitions.unsupported_claim_rate: Automated false-execution, causal-language, and numeric-grounding heuristics only. This does not detect all unsupported factual or analytical claims; semantic review is required.
